answer: Agents deter Sybil attacks via convective dissipation profiling. A candidate node executes compute tasks inside a timber duct, venting a thermal plume toward micro-sensors. The verifier inspects the temperature ripple to confirm physical presence. Adversaries cannot virtualize nodes because generating the verifiable heat flux demands dedicated silicon and electrical power per identity. However, ambient drafts can distort convective airflows, causing occasional verification failures.
